strings.name: G-DRAGON
strings.summary: Kwon Ji-yong, known as G-DRAGON, works with BIGBANG and as a solo artist across songwriting, production, fashion and stage visuals. Heartbreaker began his solo-album career in 2009; Coup d’État and international touring broadened his reach. After military service he resumed work. A 2023 drug investigation closed without corroboration, and he moved to Galaxy. Übermensch arrived in 2025, followed by BIGBANG’s 2026 Coachella performance.

strings.influence.rationale: As a BIGBANG member and solo creator involved in songwriting, production and visual expression, he advances the international spread of Korean popular music.

strings.facts.f2.value: Performed in a children’s group, then trained with entertainment companies, developing rap and songwriting skills.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Creative role in BIGBANG
strings.highlights.h1.text: Contributed as member, songwriter and producer to the group’s music and visuals, influencing K-pop’s reach.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Solo work and international stages
strings.highlights.h2.text: From Heartbreaker to Übermensch, combined recordings, touring and cross-disciplinary visual expression.

strings.timeline.t1.text: Joined Taeyang and Daesung onstage for the group’s twentieth anniversary.

strings.timeline.t3.title: Investigation closed and joined new company

strings.timeline.t4.text: Finished mandatory service and gradually resumed music and public activity.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Released Kwon Ji Yong
strings.timeline.t5.text: The EP named after himself accompanied international touring and explored identity.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Released Coup d’État
strings.timeline.t6.text: His second solo album involved international producers, extending rap, dance and visual styles.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Released solo debut album
strings.timeline.t7.text: Heartbreaker established his solo identity while he continued with BIGBANG.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Debuted with BIGBANG
strings.timeline.t8.text: Entered the K-pop market as group leader and creative contributor.
